semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Forge Nano provides advanced nano-coating technology that enhances material properties critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Forge Nano specializes in advanced nano-coating technology using Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) to improve material properties in semiconductor manufacturing. Their Atomic Armor platform addresses issues like thermal instability and surface degradation, offering solutions that enhance performance and reliability in semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.United States: Based outside of Denver, CO., Forge Nano operates as a global leader in surface engineering and precision nano-coating technology.
